tool.name: eScriptorium
tool.description: segment, transcribe and train models on images and PDFs
tool.command: #import os #import shlex #def stage($datasets, $folder) #for $index, $dataset in enumerate($datasets) #if $dataset #set $name = str($dataset.element_identifier).replace('/', '_').replace("'", '_') #if '.' not in $name #set $name = $name + '.' + str($dataset.ext) #end if #set $target = 'inputs/%s/%04d' % ($folder, $index) mkdir -p '$target' && ln -s '$dataset' '$target/$name' && #end if #end for #end def ## Each document gets a folder with its name, the page names and the numbered pages. #set $docs = [(str($d.element_identifier), [$d]) for $d in ($images or []) if $d] #set $docs = $docs + [(str($r.pages.name), list($r.pages)) for $r in $documents] #for $doc_index, $doc in enumerate($docs) #set $folder = 'inputs/documents/%04d' % $doc_index mkdir -p '$folder' && printf %s ${shlex.quote($doc[0])} > '$folder/name' && : > '$folder/names' && #for $page_index, $page in enumerate($doc[1]) #set $page_stem = os.path.splitext(str($page.element_identifier))[0] #set $page_link = '%s/%04d.%s' % ($folder, $page_index, str($page.ext)) ln -s '$page' '$page_link' && printf '%s\n' ${shlex.quote($page_stem)} >> '$folder/names' && #end for #end for $stage($annotations, 'annotations') $stage($segmentation_models, 'segmentation') $stage($recognition_models, 'recognition') exec bash '$__tool_directory__/start.sh'

param.name: images
param.label: Images or PDFs
param.help: Each selected file becomes one document named after the dataset.

param.name: pages
param.label: Collection of images or PDFs
param.help: The collection becomes one document named after the collection. Pages follow the element order.

param.name: annotations
param.label: PAGE or ALTO annotations
param.help: XML files or zip archives. An XML file is imported into the document that holds its image file name, zip archives into every document.

tool.help:
Opens eScriptorium with one project. Every selected image or PDF and every selected collection becomes one document. A collection document is named after the collection and holds its pages in element order. At least one image, PDF or collection is required. Annotations and models are imported into the session. An annotation XML file goes to the document that holds the image named in it.
Exports created in eScriptorium and all models of the session are added to the history as separate datasets when the tool is stopped. Wait for an export to finish before stopping the tool.
